rows.original: [var0 |“Kkssh!” Exhaustion clenches the snake’s eyes. You’ve run the ‘overqueen’ ragged, and with one final attack, send her reeling towards a corner of the room damaged in your fight. Electricity arcs from a spot of broken circuitry, wild frayed cables sparking and crackling. Seeing her writhing unsteadily towards live, wiggling wires, like a pedestrian stumbling into the path of a rampaging truck, snaps you into a completely different frame of mind. [pc.nmh |She may have been your enemy, but does she deserve that? Will your conscience let you stand idle? |Do you save your enemy...? She attacked you, but...! |No less than she deserves... but there may be something to gain from having her in your back pocket... ] You must act soon. |“W-Why... hhsss...” The ‘overqueen’ staggers in reverse, fighting a losing battle against kindled urges... yet in her ponderous, wriggling shadow, electrical arcs can be seen. Loose damaged cables wriggle out from a broken compartment, blue light snapping at the frayed tips. Your opponent writhes in the direction of a potentially lethal hazard, inserting you into a completely different frame of mind. [pc.nmh |Nobody deserves what’s about to happen to her... but she’s not subdued, only distracted. She could catch you in another trap, but can you leave her to fate? |She brought it on herself... it’s her fault... yet no matter how you try to justify it, part of you doesn’t want to see the woman fried...! |It’s not that you care about what happens to those who threaten you... but there is merit in having power over your enemies. She will owe you... ] You must decide, fast. ]

It is clear we are not enemies... ssso can we not be more?”[var2| She grasps at your hand, coiling her fingers around the wrist, then places it on her chest. “...I enjoyed that.”| Her tongue flickers across her luscious lips. The invitation - a hot, teasing hum - is clear.] If you’re interested in bedding a queen, how might she show you how thankful she is?
rows.translation: [pc.clMulti mercenary engineer smuggler kineticist|不需要花哨技巧，只管冲向危险并随机应变。佣兵训练曾把你送上或送到许多前线附近，有时甚至夹在两军之间，在恐慌中磨炼出勇气。你虽然没有最好的计划，却懂得比任何人更快临场判断...也懂得多快撤走伤员。转移她的冲势，把她从必然悲剧中救下？这不过是星期一。|怎样阻止电涌？很简单...只要距离足够近。你抿紧嘴唇...有了！[var0|你扔下武器，解开护盾腰带——你从不会在没调好阻尼器时穿这种东西！你将装备远远掷向角落；轰然一声，像变压器爆炸...随后什么也没发生。房间灯光熄灭，凯瑟利免遭电烤。看来腰带也毫发无伤！|无线电力传输...房间里一定有接入点；哒、哒、哒嘎——...灯光熄灭；电源停用，蛇女获救。干得好，我！]|想想：眼下能用什么切断电力？堵住它？吸收它？箱子、金属、垃圾、废物...等等，在那里！瓦砾后方！你极敏锐的余光发现一台熟悉控制台——你扑过去按下最大的按钮...随后呼吸。房间灯光熄灭，电流停止...曾经的敌人免于脑袋被烤熟。多亏了你！|你条件反射地向垂落电线伸出一臂，集中精神，手指在半空迅速而谨慎地舞动。松脱电线随之彼此编织，最终形成一条更易处理的线缆。你握拳，手臂作出上勾动作。一股无形力量将电线团送上天花板，电弧接触电力主干，引发短路。火花飞溅，随后归于寂静。你甩去指尖的麻痒，放心地叹了口气；你成功切断了电力。|慌乱中，你看见一个应急灭火器从附近墙面落下。运气不错，你心想。你迅速抓住罐体，摇晃几下，拉出软管，对准垂落电线扣下扳机。阻燃泡沫没有丝毫停顿地从喷嘴射出，立刻隔绝电弧，使其无法接触。] 至高女王花了片刻才理解刚才发生的一切。眼神稳定下来后，她以坐姿倚着墙，散发出几分英雄[pc.mf||女英雄]崇拜。战斗结束后，只剩尴尬。不妨打破沉默。 [pc.nmh|“你还好吗？”|“你经常来这里吗？”|“你一开始就该这样。”] “令——人生疑。”她从上到下打量你，表情像是在噘嘴。“我不会展现同等仁慈。” 不知为何，你对此表示怀疑。“所以，你想知道我为什么来这里？” 这一切蠢透了。你根本不该在这里。你从没打算来这里。你讲述一场逼迫自己降落空间站、与居民争斗的亲族破坏故事时，毫不掩饰声音中的愤慨。尽管你[pc.nmh|很抱歉打扰她的行动|对自己的到来造成麻烦深表同情|一点也不为痛揍她的打捞者感到抱歉]，却根本没人给你机会，让你直接提出需求然后离开。你的“至高女王”听得入神。 “我只需要这个，随后就会离开你的头——”你咳了一声。“——鳞片。”你笑着示意。“这满足你的好奇了吗[pc.isMischievous|，还是我得开始夸大自己的夸张说法]？” 她上半身歪向一侧。“所以你不是渗透者，不是竞争对手。”一声缓慢细腻的嘶鸣；她滑到近处...亲密无间的近处。“该道歉的是我。这场误会本可避免。我过于确信，而且又一次...错了。我错得厉害。” 她的承认带着可以感知的力量。 “我们在太多任务里遭过攻击！这令我们疑神疑鬼；我们不得不防守一切，先开枪，什么也不问；这座空间站是恩赐，是你们所说的‘重大突破’。可是...还——是。他们成群结队，而你只有一个。我不该如此鬼鬼祟祟，应该更仔细观察。我不会忘记——我以名誉保证，并致以最真——诚的歉意。” 很好，事情解决了。你有没有机会不受骚扰地走回飞船？你暗示只要她召回打手，自己会在她察觉前走得无影无踪... “嗯，可以安排——但是！”她嘴唇勾出朦胧笑容，眉毛性感地眯起。她想要某个东西[var1|；她的兴奋重新显现，让你猜到那是什么|]。“为什么这么快离开？我还没有表达感谢，而且还有许多话想说。显然我们不是敌人...那为什么不能发展得更多？”[var2|她抓住你的手，手指绕住手腕，再将它放到自己胸口。“...我很享受刚才。”|她的舌头弹过丰美嘴唇。那份邀请——一道滚烫挑逗的哼声——清楚无比。] 如果你有兴趣与女王上床，她会怎样表达谢意？
rows.raw: " [pc.clMulti mercenary engineer smuggler kineticist|No fancy tricks, just run towards danger and think on your feet. Training as a mercenary has put you on or near several frontlines and sometimes in-between, developing bravery in panic. While you don’t have the best plan, you know how to intuit situations in the moment faster than anyone else... and how quickly to extract the wounded. Redirecting her momentum and saving her from certain tragedy? That’s Monday.|How do you stop an electrical surge? That’s easy... if you were close enough. As your lips pull back... eureka! [var0|You drop your weapons, unbuckle your shield belt - you never wear one of these without tuning the dampeners! You long-toss the equipment into the corner; there’s a boom, like a transformer going off... and nothing. The lights are killed in the room, and the caesselian is saved a frying time. Looks like your belt is just fine, too!|A wireless transmission of power... there has to be an access point in the room; tap-tap-tap GRRRNNNNN... and the lights are killed; power deactivated, snake-lady saved. Nice going, self!]|Think: what can you use right now to kill the power? Staunch it? Absorb it? Boxes, metal, junk, crap... wait, there! Behind the rubble! A console familiar to your hyperacute peripheries - you leap at it and hit the biggest button... and breathe. The lights to the room are killed, the electricity stopped... and your once-foe saved from having her noodle cooked. Thanks to you!|Reflexively extending an arm in the direction of the dangling wires, you concentrate, moving your fingers in a rapid yet careful dance in the open air. In response, the loose wires are braided into each other until you are left with a more manageable cord. You then ball your hand and swing your arm in an uppercut motion. An invisible force sends the mass of wires upwards and into the ceiling where the arcs of electricity make contact with the electrical main, causing a short circuit. Sparks fly and then, silence. You shake away the tingles from your finger tips and sigh, relieved that you’ve successfully cut the power.|In a bit of a panic, you spot an emergency extinguisher fall from a nearby wall. Lucky breaks, you think to yourself. You quickly grab the tank, shake it, pull the hose out, point it at the dangling wires and depress the trigger. Without skipping a beat, the flame-retardant foam ejects from the nozzle and instantly insulates the electrical arcs from making contact.] It takes the Overqueen a little while to catch up on what has transpired. Once her eyes have steadied, she lolls against the wall in a sitting posture, glowing with a bit of hero[pc.mf||ine] worship. Without the fight, there’s only awkwardness. Might as well break the ice. [pc.nmh|“Are you alright?”|“You come here often?”|“This is how you should have started.”] “Sssuspicious.” Her eyes roam you up and down. Something like a pout. “I would not have shown the same mercy.” Somehow, you doubt that. “So, you want to know why I’m here?” It’s fucking stupid. You shouldn’t be here. You never intended to come here. You don’t try to hide the indignation in your voice as you tell a story of filial sabotage that forced you to land on this station and tussle with its inhabitants. While you [pc.nmh|are sorry for disturbing her operation|are sympathetic to the trouble your arrival has caused|aren’t sorry about beating up her salvagers], you weren’t exactly given the opportunity to just ask for what you wanted to get a move on. Your ‘Overqueen’ listens, raptly. “All I need is this, and I’m out of your hai -” You cough. “- scales.” You gesture, smirking. “Does that satisfy your curiosity[pc.isMischievous|, or do I have to start exaggerating my exaggerations]?” Her upper body tilts to one side. “So you are not an infiltrator. Not a rival.” A slow, delicate hiss; she glides close... intimately close. “It is I who should apologize. This misunderstanding could have been avoided. I was too sure, and once again I was... wrong. I was very wrong.” There’s palpable force in her admittance. “We’ve been attacked on too many jobs! It made us paranoid; we had to defend everything, shoot first, ask nothing; this station was a blessing, the ‘big break’ you might say. Still... sssstill. They were in groups, and you are just one. I should not have acted so surreptitiously. I should have paid closer attention. I will not forget this - you have my word, and sinceressst apologies.” Good, that’s settled. Any chance you can have an unmolested walk back to your ship? You intimate that you’ll be long gone before she even knows it... if she’ll call off the goons. “Hmm, that can be arranged - but!” Her lips curve into a smoky grin; her brow narrows sultrily. She wants something[var1|, and you have an idea what that might be as her arousal reasserts|]. “Why leave so soon? I haven’t yet shown you my gratitude, and there’s much I would like to say. It is clear we are not enemies... ssso can we not be more?”[var2| She grasps at your hand, coiling her fingers around the wrist, then places it on her chest. “...I enjoyed that.”| Her tongue flickers across her luscious lips. The invitation - a hot, teasing hum - is clear.] If you’re interested in bedding a queen, how might she show you how thankful she is? "

rows.original: Priests everywhere will praise you for resisting temptation like this. Save a woman’s life - a queen, ostensibly! - and turn down the offer to tango? Say it ain’t so! [pc.name] must be touched by divinity, or some malarkey! But that’s your decision. You shake your head, and simply offer a [pc.hand] to her. “An understanding between us is fine,” you start. “[pc.nmh|My name is [pc.name], though. Let’s try to avoid coming to blows in the future, yes?|Now, I’m only giving you my name because you’re cute... and because I’d rather us avoid the fighting if we meet again. [pc.name].|You can call me [pc.name]. Don’t linger on it, though. I’m just making sure you know who not to attack.]” She accepts, and rises. “Overqueen Mel’Ysolte of the Mellifla Clan. I respect your answer, sssavior [pc.name].” There’s a ticklish feel in your gut when she says that. Recognition is nice. “I will ensure that my employees do not harangue you again. Perhaps we will meet again one day. May it be a more peaceful encounter.” That’d be nice. She departs through the door, and is gone entirely. Disappeared into the crust of the station like a worm. [silly|Macguffin|Vital repair part] in hand, you stow it away. The Rush awaits! (Key Item Gained: Plasma Conduit)
rows.translation: 各地祭司都会赞颂你抵挡这种诱惑的意志。救了一名女人——表面上还是女王！——却拒绝共舞的提议？说这不是真的！[pc.name]一定受到神明感召，或者类似的胡扯！ 但这就是你的决定。你摇摇头，只向她伸出一只[pc.hand]。“我们达成谅解就好，”你开口。“[pc.nmh|不过，我叫[pc.name]。以后尽量避免再次动手，好吗？|好了，我告诉你名字只是因为你很可爱...也因为如果再次见面，我希望我们别再打架。[pc.name]。|你可以叫我[pc.name]。不过别一直想着它。我只是确保你知道谁不该攻击。]” 她接受你的手，起身站立。“梅利弗拉氏族的至高女王梅尔·伊索尔特。我尊重你的回答，救——命恩人[pc.name]。”她这样称呼时，你腹中泛起一阵痒意。获得认可确实很不错。“我会确保员工不再骚扰你。或许我们有朝一日还会相见。希望那次会面更加和平。” 那一定很好。她穿门离开，彻底消失，像虫子钻入空间站外壳。[silly|关键道具|关键维修部件]已经到手，你将其收起。星球淘金潮还在等着！ （获得关键物品：等离子导管）

rows.original: You can put the end result out of sight, but not the sounds. Not entirely, anyway. There’s a light show, noises that sapient mouths were never meant to make... and nothing. The room falls silent, and darker. The smell of charred leather rises. It’s a wrench trying to lay eyes on the scaly heap in the corner. A sense of unease crawls over your brow... but you can see breathing. Is there a pulse? [pc.nmh|She’ll live; her scales will stir. Well, nothing for it. Check her belongings... money... anything else? There. Plasma conduit? Yoink. Time to get going. You’ve been stalled long enough.|Your conscience is assuaged by the thudding of her vitals. That’s how this ends, then. She will stir, in time. To the victor the spoils, though! Fucking finally! You resolve to give [rival.name] one good punch. Just one. It’ll feel so good.|The pan-fried noodle is cooked... but not well and done. You smirk at her - oh, there’s a pulse, but she’ll not be moving for a while. Take what you can. And here you go... your ticket off this rock. Fucking [rival.name]. You promise to make [rival.himHer] pay for this, one day...] (Key Item Gained: Plasma Conduit)

rows.original: He makes a good point. If you need help before you even make it to the frontier, you’ll never last out there - to say nothing of the damage you could do to your future company and your father’s legacy. You thank the executive for the advice and resolve to fix your ship on your own, but it’s nice to know that you have a fallback for when food and determination run low.

rows.original: You already made the call to save Tika.
rows.translation: 你已经打电话要求营救蒂卡了。
rows.raw: "You already made the call to save Tika."

rows.translation: 营救蒂卡

rows.original: Before wrapping up the call, you bring up Tika - or T1-K4 as she’s properly known. For a medical bot to stay functional this long - and function so well is nothing short of remarkable. JoyCo’s V-Ko line rarely last more than two decades. Tika’s still going well past that, and still enduring heavy use by the station’s intruders if her reprogrammed subroutines are anything to go by.
rows.translation: 挂断电话之前，你提起了蒂卡——或者按正式名称称呼她，T1-K4。一台医疗机器人能运行这么久，而且表现依然如此出色，简直堪称奇迹。悦乐公司的V-KO系列很少能使用超过二十年。蒂卡已经远远超过这个期限却仍在正常运转；若重新编写的子程序能说明什么，她还一直承受着空间站入侵者的高强度使用。
rows.raw: "Before wrapping up the call, you bring up Tika - or T1-K4 as she’s properly known. For a medical bot to stay functional this long - and function so well is nothing short of remarkable. JoyCo’s V-Ko line rarely last more than two decades. Tika’s still going well past that, and still enduring heavy use by the station’s intruders if her reprogrammed subroutines are anything to go by."

rows.original: “Yes, I see her in the manifest. She was a state of the art prototype undergoing testing as a potential competitor to what became the V-Ko line of nurse-droids.” The mystery voice whistles. “Pretty pricy for her time. Data’s sure to be useless by now, but we’ll get her looked over and set up in a new home. Maybe even restart the nurse-bot program...” By now the constant typing from the other end has started to fade from notice. “Alright, I’ve left the salvage team some notes. Anything else I can do for you [pc.MisterMiss] Steele?”
rows.translation: “对，我在清单上看见她了。她当时是最先进的原型机，正在接受测试，目标是成为后来V-KO系列护理机器人的竞争产品。”神秘声音吹了声口哨。“以那个年代而言，她可相当昂贵。数据现在肯定已经毫无用处，但我们会替她进行检查，再安排一个新家。说不定还能重启护理机器人项目...”到了现在，另一端持续不断的打字声已经逐渐淡出你的注意。“好了，我给打捞团队留了几条备注。斯蒂尔[pc.MisterMiss]，还有其他需要我做的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, I see her in the manifest. She was a state of the art prototype undergoing testing as a potential competitor to what became the V-Ko line of nurse-droids.” The mystery voice whistles. “Pretty pricy for her time. Data’s sure to be useless by now, but we’ll get her looked over and set up in a new home. Maybe even restart the nurse-bot program...” By now the constant typing from the other end has started to fade from notice. “Alright, I’ve left the salvage team some notes. Anything else I can do for you [pc.MisterMiss] Steele?”"

rows.translation: 营救蒂卡

rows.original: What happened to T1-K4 can’t happen again. Make sure they pick her up and put her to work somewhere.
rows.translation: 绝不能让T1-K4身上发生的事再次重演。确保他们把她接走，并安排到某个地方工作。
rows.raw: "What happened to T1-K4 can’t happen again. Make sure they pick her up and put her to work somewhere."

rows.translation: 已锁定
已锁定

rows.original: You need to meet someone else on FIRST-14 before using this topic.
rows.translation: 使用这个话题之前，你需要先在FIRST-14上遇见另一个人。
rows.raw: "You need to meet someone else on FIRST-14 before using this topic."

rows.translation: FIRST-14
返回FIRST-14

rows.original: With your ship in working order, this trip to Ferro Industrial Reclamation Station T-14 is so much smoother. You wonder if anyone has chased off the salvagers yet. Probably not.
rows.translation: 飞船恢复正常运行后，这趟前往费罗工业回收站T-14的旅程顺畅多了。你不知道是否已经有人赶走那些打捞者。大概没有。
rows.raw: "With your ship in working order, this trip to Ferro Industrial Reclamation Station T-14 is so much smoother. You wonder if anyone has chased off the salvagers yet. Probably not."

rows.original: Rather than setting your [pc.foot] down on the ancient, creaky deck plates, you find yourself floating in zero G. The station’s artificial gravity appears to be out, even if you can still hear the faint whirr of functional life support and the flicker of barely lit emergency lighting. Fortunately, there’s plenty of objects in this hangar to grab onto and propel yourself around with; the closest is a mountain of empty freight containers, piled up to the west. The rest of the hangar stretches away to the north, with a distant airlock visible in the distance to the northwest.
rows.translation: 你没有把[pc.foot]踩上古老而吱呀作响的甲板，而是发现自己漂浮在零重力中。空间站的人工重力似乎已经失效，尽管你仍能听见正常生命维持系统的微弱嗡鸣，也看得见几乎不亮的应急灯光闪烁。幸运的是，机库里有很多物体可供抓握，借力推动自己四处移动；离你最近的是西侧堆成山的空货运箱。机库其余部分向北延伸，西北方远处可以看见一座气闸。
rows.raw: "Rather than setting your [pc.foot] down on the ancient, creaky deck plates, you find yourself floating in zero G. The station’s artificial gravity appears to be out, even if you can still hear the faint whirr of functional life support and the flicker of barely lit emergency lighting. Fortunately, there’s plenty of objects in this hangar to grab onto and propel yourself around with; the closest is a mountain of empty freight containers, piled up to the west. The rest of the hangar stretches away to the north, with a distant airlock visible in the distance to the northwest."

rows.original: Ancient deck plates creak as you step onto them. While still structurally sound, stripes of reddish-orange oxidation mar the once pristine alloy. Patches of caked-on carbon linger like oil stains in a mechanic’s garage. Empty freight containers, half collapsed into themselves, form a mountain of unstable detritus to the west that you dare tread upon. The rest of the hangar stretches away to the north, toward a distant airlock to the northwest.
rows.translation: 你踏上古老甲板时，它们发出吱呀声。结构虽然依然稳固，但一道道红橙色氧化痕迹损毁了曾经完美无瑕的合金。板结的积碳像机修车库里的油渍一样残留其上。西侧的空货运箱半数已经塌陷，堆成一座摇摇欲坠的废物山，你不敢踩上去。机库其余部分向北延伸，通往西北方远处的一座气闸。
rows.raw: "Ancient deck plates creak as you step onto them. While still structurally sound, stripes of reddish-orange oxidation mar the once pristine alloy. Patches of caked-on carbon linger like oil stains in a mechanic’s garage. Empty freight containers, half collapsed into themselves, form a mountain of unstable detritus to the west that you dare tread upon. The rest of the hangar stretches away to the north, toward a distant airlock to the northwest."

rows.original: A few dozen feet to the east lies the empty void of space, held at bay by the unstable energy of an ancient containment screen. It would be wise not to dawdle here.
rows.translation: 东面几十英尺外便是空无一物的太空，被一面古老遏制力场不稳定的能量挡在外面。最好不要在此逗留。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few dozen feet to the east lies the empty void of space, held at bay by the unstable energy of an ancient containment screen. It would be wise not to dawdle here."

rows.translation: 一艘货运飞船

rows.original: lingers nose down on the tarmac
rows.translation: 机头朝下停在停机坪上

rows.translation: ，已经凹陷到无法修复。它的大部分推进装置都在

那次

rows.original: impact. Whoever crashed it didn’t spare the effort of salvaging a single bolt nor chewed-up seat cushion. Bizarre, acid-etched pits mar the ground around it, marking exactly where power cells ruptured their caustic guts onto the deck.
rows.translation: 撞击中被刮掉了。无论是谁让它坠毁，都没有费心回收哪怕一颗螺栓或一块被啃烂的座椅软垫。周围地面散布着被酸蚀出的怪异凹坑，精确标记出动力电池破裂、将腐蚀性内脏泼洒到甲板上的位置。
rows.raw: " impact. Whoever crashed it didn’t spare the effort of salvaging a single bolt nor chewed-up seat cushion. Bizarre, acid-etched pits mar the ground around it, marking exactly where power cells ruptured their caustic guts onto the deck."

rows.original: Your own vessel remains parked directly to the south. Open hangar space expands out to the north and west, with a distant airlock where the north and west walls join together.
rows.translation: 你自己的飞船仍停在正南方。空旷机库向北面和西面延伸，北墙与西墙交汇处有一座远处的气闸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour own vessel remains parked directly to the south. Open hangar space expands out to the north and west, with a distant airlock where the north and west walls join together."

rows.original: A sign of gleaming stainless steel hangs on the hangar’s northern wall, proudly proclaiming: Welcome to Ferro Industrial Reclamation Station T-14. There’s room behind it for some kind of backlighting system, but judging by the crumbly
rows.translation: 一块闪亮的不锈钢标牌挂在机库北墙，骄傲地宣告：欢迎来到费罗工业回收站T-14。标牌背后留有某种背光系统的位置，但从附近那团松散的
rows.raw: "A sign of gleaming stainless steel hangs on the hangar’s northern wall, proudly proclaiming: Welcome to Ferro Industrial Reclamation Station T-14. There’s room behind it for some kind of backlighting system, but judging by the crumbly "

rows.translation: 云雾
堆积物
状橡胶与烧焦电路
正飘浮在附近
正散落在你的[pc.footOrFeet]边

rows.translation: 来看，那套系统已经被岁月或劫掠者夺走。食品包装、塑料杯和开裂的储物箱也在

rows.translation: 这片区域
地面的许多地方
堆得到处都是。

rows.original: While the cold vacuum of space lies east, just on the other side of the atmospheric containment field, the hangar stretches west toward a backup airlock. You can still see your vessel in the distance to the south.
rows.translation: 冰冷的太空真空就在东面，仅与这里隔着一道大气遏制力场；机库则向西延伸，通往一座备用气闸。你仍能看见自己的飞船停在南方远处。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the cold vacuum of space lies east, just on the other side of the atmospheric containment field, the hangar stretches west toward a backup airlock. You can still see your vessel in the distance to the south."

rows.translation: 拿下。
成功！

rows.original: The security field flickers once before collapsing on itself, another victim of poorly secured software. You can proceed freely!
rows.translation: 安保力场闪烁了一次，随后向内坍缩，成为又一个不安全软件的受害者。你现在可以自由通过了！
rows.raw: "The security field flickers once before collapsing on itself, another victim of poorly secured software. You can proceed freely!"

rows.translation: 继续
成功！

rows.original: Bingo! The security field flickers and dies without a source of power, leaving you free to float through the old station at your leisure.
rows.translation: 成了！安保力场闪烁后熄灭，失去能源供应的它再也无法阻挡你；现在你可以随心所欲地漂过这座古老空间站。
rows.raw: "Bingo! The security field flickers and dies without a source of power, leaving you free to float through the old station at your leisure."

Rerouting Minigame:

线路重接小游戏：

"Rerouting Minigame:
  • To win, connect the emitter nodes to the goal nodes.
  • Rotate the interactive nodes by selecting them.

rows.original: Someone didn’t bother to close the airlock. They set up a security field instead. You can still see where they jacked into the station’s systems and configured the blazing wall of hardlight, semitransparent and yet stronger than any known steel
rows.translation: 有人懒得关上气闸，转而设置了一道安保力场。你仍能看出他们接入空间站系统、配置这面炽亮硬光墙的位置；它半透明，却比任何已知钢材都更加坚固
rows.raw: "Someone didn’t bother to close the airlock. They set up a security field instead. You can still see where they jacked into the station’s systems and configured the blazing wall of hardlight, semitransparent and yet stronger than any known steel"

joinAfter.expression: isSillyModeEnabled() ? " - only because it has yet to meet this Steele!" : "."

rows.original: - only because it has yet to meet this Steele!
rows.translation: ——这只是因为它还没遇见这位斯蒂尔！
rows.raw: " - only because it has yet to meet this Steele!"

rows.original: Such fields are proof against bullets, hammers, and even lasers. You’ll need to cough up a 9-digit pin if you want to get through any time soon, and you sincerely doubt the station’s other visitors left the passcode taped to a wall for you to find.
rows.translation: 这种力场能够抵挡子弹、锤子，甚至激光。如果想尽快通过，你得输入一个九位数密码；而你深切怀疑空间站里的其他访客会把密码贴在墙上等你发现。
rows.raw: " Such fields are proof against bullets, hammers, and even lasers. You’ll need to cough up a 9-digit pin if you want to get through any time soon, and you sincerely doubt the station’s other visitors left the passcode taped to a wall for you to find."

rows.original: You could pop open a panel and reroute the power relays to starve the field
rows.translation: 你可以撬开一块面板，重新连接电力继电器，切断力场能源
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could pop open a panel and reroute the power relays to starve the field"

rows.original: , though you recognize this particular model; it’s one with a software vulnerability you learned about in your time as a tech specialist. Using your knowledge will make bypassing the security shield’s systems all the easier
rows.translation: ；不过你认得这个特定型号：它存在一个你担任技术专家时曾了解过的软件漏洞。利用自己的知识，绕过安保力场系统会容易得多
rows.raw: ", though you recognize this particular model; it’s one with a software vulnerability you learned about in your time as a tech specialist. Using your knowledge will make bypassing the security shield’s systems all the easier"

rows.translation: 利用漏洞
成功入侵！

rows.original: You jack into the closest terminal, and sure enough, nobody bothered to update the security gate’s firmware. All you need to do is route your exploit through a firewall vulnerability, and the station will be yours...
rows.translation: 你接入最近的终端；果然，根本没人费心更新安保门的固件。你只需要让漏洞利用程序通过一处防火墙弱点，整座空间站便会任你通行...
rows.raw: "You jack into the closest terminal, and sure enough, nobody bothered to update the security gate’s firmware. All you need to do is route your exploit through a firewall vulnerability, and the station will be yours..."

rows.translation: 开始
返回
利用漏洞

rows.original: Exploit the software vulnerability to make bypassing the security field easier. (Easier minigame)
rows.translation: 利用软件漏洞，让绕过安全力场变得更容易。(降低小游戏难度)
rows.raw: "Exploit the software vulnerability to make bypassing the security field easier. (Easier minigame)"

rows.original: , though with all the industrial scrap scattered around the hangar, it might be easier to lean on your time spent as a mercenary and cobble together a small shaped charge to blow out the obstacle. You just need to find something you can massage into exploding
rows.translation: ，不过机库里到处散落着工业废料，也许利用你当佣兵时积累的经验，拼个小型聚能炸药炸开障碍会更容易。你只需要找些能鼓捣成爆炸物的东西
rows.raw: ", though with all the industrial scrap scattered around the hangar, it might be easier to lean on your time spent as a mercenary and cobble together a small shaped charge to blow out the obstacle. You just need to find something you can massage into exploding"

rows.translation: 炸弹
炸弹人
当心爆炸

rows.original: Kneeling so close to the field that you can feel the energy dancing along the [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] of your arm, you place the impromptu bomb’s pieces, then wedge a wireless detonator squarely in its center. Ever since your first merc gig, you kept a few handfuls on your person, just in case you needed to make something go boom.
rows.translation: 你跪在力场旁，近得足以感到能量沿着手臂的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]跃动。你将临时炸弹的零件摆好，再把无线引爆器牢牢塞进正中央。自从第一次干佣兵活起，你身上就一直备着几枚，以防什么时候需要让东西炸个响。
rows.raw: "Kneeling so close to the field that you can feel the energy dancing along the [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] of your arm, you place the impromptu bomb’s pieces, then wedge a wireless detonator squarely in its center. Ever since your first merc gig, you kept a few handfuls on your person, just in case you needed to make something go boom."

rows.original: Now is one of those times. You swim back through the zero G, smiling giddily as you prime your Codex’s transmitter to broadcast the signal. It takes two seconds to pair. Your finger trembles above the detonation prompt when it appears. You exhale and push it.
rows.translation: 现在正是时候。你在失重环境中游回去，兴奋地笑着调试Codex的发射器，让它广播信号。配对只花了两秒。引爆提示出现时，你的手指在上方微微颤抖。你呼出一口气，按了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow is one of those times. You swim back through the zero G, smiling giddily as you prime your Codex’s transmitter to broadcast the signal. It takes two seconds to pair. Your finger trembles above the detonation prompt when it appears. You exhale and push it."

rows.original: Up close explosions are so much better than the ones in the holos. Yes, they’re louder, but you don’t really hear them. You feel them. The blastwave of kinetic energy rattles through your very bones. It ripples through organic flesh like the deepest of tissue massages, and as you shake your head and wait for the ringing in your ears to stop, you relish the smoky aftermath as only a trained mercenary could.
rows.translation: 近距离的爆炸可比全息影像里的带劲多了。没错，声音更响，但你其实听不见。你会感觉到它。动能形成的冲击波震得你骨头都在颤。它像最深层的组织按摩一样穿过血肉；你摇着头等待耳鸣消退，以只有受过训练的佣兵才懂的方式享受着烟雾弥漫的余韵。
rows.raw: "\n\nUp close explosions are so much better than the ones in the holos. Yes, they’re louder, but you don’t really hear them. You feel them. The blastwave of kinetic energy rattles through your very bones. It ripples through organic flesh like the deepest of tissue massages, and as you shake your head and wait for the ringing in your ears to stop, you relish the smoky aftermath as only a trained mercenary could."

rows.original: Nobody died, and aside from some major scoring on the wall panels and excessive scorch marks, the station is undamaged. Another successful op!
rows.translation: 没人死亡，除了墙板上几道严重划痕和过多的焦痕，空间站也完好无损。又一次行动成功！
rows.raw: "\n\nNobody died, and aside from some major scoring on the wall panels and excessive scorch marks, the station is undamaged. Another successful op!"

rows.translation: 下一步
炸弹

rows.original: Hacking is a boring choice anyway.
rows.translation: 反正黑客入侵也是个无聊的选择。
炸弹
炸弹

rows.original: You do not have a sufficiently explosive bomb. Maybe you can find the parts to make one by searching around the hangar?
rows.translation: 你没有爆炸威力足够的炸弹。也许可以搜查机库，找到材料做一个？
rows.raw: "You do not have a sufficiently explosive bomb. Maybe you can find the parts to make one by searching around the hangar?"

rows.original: . You picked up on an old smuggler’s trick on your last job that ought to work perfectly here. All you have to do is overload your personal energy shield against the hardlight wall at just the right frequency, and it should collapse faster than tissue paper in a tsunami
rows.translation: 。你上次干活时学过一个走私客的老把戏，正好适合这里。你只要让个人能量护盾以恰当频率贴着硬光墙过载，它崩溃的速度就会比海啸里的薄纸还快
rows.raw: ". You picked up on an old smuggler’s trick on your last job that ought to work perfectly here. All you have to do is overload your personal energy shield against the hardlight wall at just the right frequency, and it should collapse faster than tissue paper in a tsunami"

rows.translation: 过载
正在过载...

rows.original: ...and wake up on your back, smoking slightly but apparently unharmed.
rows.translation: ...然后仰面醒来，身上微微冒烟，但显然安然无恙。
rows.raw: "...and wake up on your back, smoking slightly but apparently unharmed."

rows.translation: 力场消失了。

rows.original: You did it! Jumping onto your [pc.footOrFeet], you take a quick inventory: a few bumps and bruises, but no serious damage to your person. Your belt even survived! It successfully rebooted into its standard configuration, just like last time.
rows.translation: 你成功了！你一跃站上[pc.footOrFeet]，迅速检查一遍身体：有几处磕碰和瘀伤，但没有严重损伤。就连你的腰带也挺了过来！它成功重启并恢复了标准配置，和上次一模一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou did it! Jumping onto your [pc.footOrFeet], you take a quick inventory: a few bumps and bruises, but no serious damage to your person. Your belt even survived! It successfully rebooted into its standard configuration, just like last time."

rows.original: One of these days, tricks like this are going to get you killed - or save your life.
rows.translation: 总有一天，这种把戏会害死你 - 或者救你一命。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of these days, tricks like this are going to get you killed - or save your life."

rows.translation: 你大步走到滋滋作响的能量墙前，尽可能贴近它。离得这么近，它让
rows.raw: "You stride as close to the sizzling wall of energy as you dare. This close, it makes "

rows.translation: 你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]
你的[pc.hairNoun]
你手臂上的汗毛

rows.original: bristle as you fiddle with your shield belt’s controls, setting up the overload timing and frequency modulation to a spec that ought to do the trick. You suck in a deep breath, knowing that a trick like this is liable to hurt if it goes wrong, and press the button.
rows.translation: 都竖了起来。你摆弄着护盾腰带的控制器，按照应该能奏效的参数设置过载时机和频率调制。你深吸一口气，知道这种把戏一旦出错很可能会很痛，然后按下按钮。
rows.raw: " bristle as you fiddle with your shield belt’s controls, setting up the overload timing and frequency modulation to a spec that ought to do the trick. You suck in a deep breath, knowing that a trick like this is liable to hurt if it goes wrong, and press the button."

rows.original: The emitters on your belt begin to whine, then scream, then spark as it overloads, physically pushing you back from the security field. You brace, shutting your eyes against the blinding radiance building in front of you...
rows.translation: 腰带上的发射器开始低鸣，继而尖啸，最后在过载时迸出火花，把你整个人从安全力场前推开。你稳住身体，闭眼避开面前愈发刺目的强光...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe emitters on your belt begin to whine, then scream, then spark as it overloads, physically pushing you back from the security field. You brace, shutting your eyes against the blinding radiance building in front of you..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You need a shield belt equipped to do this.
rows.translation: 你需要装备护盾腰带才能这么做。
rows.raw: "You need a shield belt equipped to do this."

rows.original: How did you lose your shield belt already? Without one, you have no option but to reroute the power.
rows.translation: 你的护盾腰带怎么已经弄丢了？没有它，你只能重新布设电力线路。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow did you lose your shield belt already? Without one, you have no option but to reroute the power."

rows.translation: 下一步
过载

rows.original: Use an old smuggler’s trick to overload the shield. As long as nothing explodes, it should work just fine. (Skip hacking minigame)
rows.translation: 用走私客的老把戏让护盾过载。只要没有东西爆炸，应该就不会有问题。(跳过黑客小游戏)
rows.raw: "Use an old smuggler’s trick to overload the shield. As long as nothing explodes, it should work just fine. (Skip hacking minigame)"

rows.original: (If you wish to proceed explosively, use the \[Search\] option elsewhere in the hangar to find materials.)
rows.translation: (如果想用爆炸手段通过，请在机库别处使用\[搜索\]选项寻找材料。)
rows.raw: "\n\n(If you wish to proceed explosively, use the \\[Search\\] option elsewhere in the hangar to find materials.)"

rows.translation: 改接线路
开始吧...

rows.original: You pop open the nearest access panel, and bingo! A tangle of wires and conduits sits in front of you. Now, all you have to do is route the flow of power around the security field without shutting off the life support...
rows.translation: 你打开最近的检修面板，找到了！一团乱麻般的电线和导管出现在眼前。现在，你只需把电力绕过安全力场，同时别关掉生命维持系统...
rows.raw: "You pop open the nearest access panel, and bingo! A tangle of wires and conduits sits in front of you. Now, all you have to do is route the flow of power around the security field without shutting off the life support..."

rows.translation: 开始
返回
改接线路

rows.original: Attempt to reroute the power away from the security shield.
rows.translation: 尝试重新布设电力线路，绕开安全护盾。
rows.raw: "Attempt to reroute the power away from the security shield."

rows.original: There used to be an emergency airlock in the western wall. Now there’s an open tunnel with meter long scorch marks and obvious rents in the walls’ cladding. Nothing can stop you exploring the deeper recesses of FIRST-14.
rows.translation: 西侧墙上原本有一道应急气闸。如今那里只剩一条敞开的通道，墙面覆层上留着数米长的焦痕和明显裂口。再也没有什么能阻止你探索FIRST-14更深处了。
rows.raw: "There used to be an emergency airlock in the western wall. Now there’s an open tunnel with meter long scorch marks and obvious rents in the walls’ cladding. Nothing can stop you exploring the deeper recesses of FIRST-14."

rows.original: The hangar stretches east and west from here. In the distance to the southeast, you can barely see the top of your parked vessel.
rows.translation: 机库从这里向东西两侧延伸。在遥远的东南方向，你勉强能看到停泊飞船的顶部。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hangar stretches east and west from here. In the distance to the southeast, you can barely see the top of your parked vessel."

rows.original: The emergency airlock is stuck wide-open, and the security field that was set up to watch it has been disabled.
rows.translation: 应急气闸卡在完全敞开的状态，用来监控它的安全力场也已停用。
rows.raw: "The emergency airlock is stuck wide-open, and the security field that was set up to watch it has been disabled. "

rows.original: Sparks still spray from the emitters after that brutish overload.
rows.translation: 那次粗暴的过载后，发射器依然向外喷溅着火花。
rows.raw: "Sparks still spray from the emitters after that brutish overload."

rows.original: The access panel you used to reroute the power is still open.
rows.translation: 你用来重新布设电力线路的检修面板还开着。
rows.raw: "The access panel you used to reroute the power is still open."

rows.original: With the thrumming hardlight elegantly toggled, the hangar seems almost too quiet.
rows.translation: 嗡鸣的硬光被巧妙关闭后，机库显得几乎过于安静。
rows.raw: "With the thrumming hardlight elegantly toggled, the hangar seems almost too quiet."

rows.original: There’s nothing to stop you from striding deeper into the station to the west now. Alternatively, the hangar stretches east and south from here, should you wish to scout the local environs before moving deeper.
rows.translation: 现在没有什么能阻止你向西深入空间站了。如果想先侦察周边再继续深入，也可以沿机库向东或向南前进。
rows.raw: " There’s nothing to stop you from striding deeper into the station to the west now. Alternatively, the hangar stretches east and south from here, should you wish to scout the local environs before moving deeper."

rows.original: You can barely spot the top of your vessel above the hangar’s detritus, parked to the southeast.
rows.translation: 你的飞船停在东南方；隔着机库里的遍地杂物，你勉强能看到它的顶部。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can barely spot the top of your vessel above the hangar’s detritus, parked to the southeast."

rows.original: The access corridor you’ve been following bends a dogleg to the north and east from this corner, but it also bumps up against another passage to the west: a huge circular vent with the grate smashed off. A powerful current of air surges through it, making it difficult just to look down that tunnel, let alone traverse it
rows.translation: 你一路走来的检修通道在这个拐角处呈直角转向北方和东方，同时还与西侧的另一条通道相接：一根巨大圆形通风管，格栅已经被砸掉。强劲的气流从中涌出，光是朝那条通道里看都很困难，更别说穿过去了
rows.raw: "The access corridor you’ve been following bends a dogleg to the north and east from this corner, but it also bumps up against another passage to the west: a huge circular vent with the grate smashed off. A powerful current of air surges through it, making it difficult just to look down that tunnel, let alone traverse it"

rows.translation: ，尤其还是在失重状态下。

rows.original: . <b>Yet the gravity is on now, and with the extra friction, you can safely travel west
rows.translation: 。<b>不过现在重力已经恢复，有了额外摩擦力，你可以安全地向西前进
rows.raw: ". <b>Yet the gravity is on now, and with the extra friction, you can safely travel west"

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 === flags.PLASMA_CONDUIT
                        ? " to claim a plasma conduit!"
                        : "."

rows.translation: ，取得一根等离子导管！

rows.original: According to your earlier scans, the part you need lies in that direction - west.
rows.translation: 根据先前的扫描结果，你需要的零件就在那个方向 - 西边。
rows.raw: "\n\nAccording to your earlier scans, the part you need lies in that direction - west."

rows.translation: 风洞
糟了！

rows.original: You heave off the entrance to the wind tunnel, launching a few feet inside, but the walls are slippery. You can’t get a handhold. You lash out with your [pc.footOrFeet] to brace, but there’s nothing to grab onto. Before you can catch yourself, the torrent of air accelerates you back down the access tunnel, sending you tumbling end over end, bouncing off hard edges and door frames before a heavy crate arrests your sideways fall - back in the hangar.
rows.translation: 你用力蹬离风洞入口，向里飞出几英尺，但管壁十分光滑。你找不到能抓住的地方。你伸出[pc.footOrFeet]试图撑住身体，却无处借力。还没来得及稳住自己，汹涌气流便让你沿检修通道加速倒飞，整个人不断翻滚，在坚硬棱角和门框之间来回碰撞，最后一个沉重货箱挡住你横飞的身体 - 把你留在了机库里。
rows.raw: "You heave off the entrance to the wind tunnel, launching a few feet inside, but the walls are slippery. You can’t get a handhold. You lash out with your [pc.footOrFeet] to brace, but there’s nothing to grab onto. Before you can catch yourself, the torrent of air accelerates you back down the access tunnel, sending you tumbling end over end, bouncing off hard edges and door frames before a heavy crate arrests your sideways fall - back in the hangar."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: This rectangular room intersects with two huge air vents, an essential part of FIRST-14’s life support systems. You came in through the one to the east after finding the vent cover removed, but the vent to the west is still locked down, held in place by an enormous grate and thumb-sized bolts. Rusty tools drape the northern wall, largely empty,
rows.translation: 这个矩形房间与两根巨型通风管相交，它们是FIRST-14生命维持系统的重要组成部分。你发现东侧通风口的盖板被拆掉，便从那里进来了；西侧通风口仍然封锁着，一面巨型格栅由拇指粗的螺栓固定在原处。北侧墙上挂着生锈的工具，大部分位置都空着，
rows.raw: "This rectangular room intersects with two huge air vents, an essential part of FIRST-14’s life support systems. You came in through the one to the east after finding the vent cover removed, but the vent to the west is still locked down, held in place by an enormous grate and thumb-sized bolts. Rusty tools drape the northern wall, largely empty, "

rows.original: but a poster remains between them: a pin-up of some kind of human-squirrel hybrid with incredible fashion sense and a porn-worthy body.
rows.translation: 但工具之间还留着一张海报：上面是一位人类与松鼠的混血模特，不仅时尚品味出众，还有一副足以登上色情杂志的身材。
rows.raw: "but a poster remains between them: a pin-up of some kind of human-squirrel hybrid with incredible fashion sense and a porn-worthy body."

rows.translation: 拿走海报
拿走海报

rows.original: Grab the poster - maybe it will look nice in your ship!
rows.translation: 拿走海报 - 也许挂在你的飞船里会很好看！
rows.raw: "Grab the poster - maybe it will look nice in your ship!"

rows.original: and all the emptier after you took the poster from between.
rows.translation: 而你把工具之间的海报拿走后，这里显得更加空荡。
rows.raw: "and all the emptier after you took the poster from between."

rows.original: The southern wall houses a doorway with a label too faded to make out. “...tant St..r..e”?
rows.translation: 南墙上有一道门，标签已经褪色得难以辨认。“...毒储..藏..室”？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe southern wall houses a doorway with a label too faded to make out. “...tant St..r..e”? "

rows.translation: 这到底是什么？

rows.original: You make a mental note to make Steele Tech invest in longer lasting inks for its labels.
rows.translation: 你暗自记下，得让斯蒂尔科技为标签采购更耐久的油墨。
rows.raw: "You make a mental note to make Steele Tech invest in longer lasting inks for its labels."

rows.original: This chamber once housed racks of tanks filled with glowing disinfectants. Now it’s a shattered remnant of its former self, doomed by age, pressure, and failed equipment to disgorge its sordid contents in a room flooding tide. You survived with the help of your hardlight tent, leaving you free to override the automatic lockdown and travel at your leisure. At least you won’t have to worry about catching a cold in here!
rows.translation: 这个舱室曾摆着一排排装有发光消毒剂的储罐。如今这里只剩昔日残破的遗迹，在岁月、压力和设备故障的摧残下，将肮脏内含物倾泻成淹没房间的浪潮。你借助硬光帐篷活了下来，现在可以解除自动封锁，自由通行。至少在这里不用担心感冒了！
rows.raw: "This chamber once housed racks of tanks filled with glowing disinfectants. Now it’s a shattered remnant of its former self, doomed by age, pressure, and failed equipment to disgorge its sordid contents in a room flooding tide. You survived with the help of your hardlight tent, leaving you free to override the automatic lockdown and travel at your leisure. At least you won’t have to worry about catching a cold in here!"

rows.original: The door to the south remains closed, labeled only as “Mechanical Storage.” Perhaps you’ll find your missing part there?
rows.translation: 南边的门仍然紧闭，上面只标着“机械储藏室”。也许你缺少的零件就在里面？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe door to the south remains closed, labeled only as “Mechanical Storage.” Perhaps you’ll find your missing part there?"

rows.original: This chamber’s purpose becomes clear the moment you see the tanks of day-glow fluid lining the walls with their still legible labels: Disinfectant. You suppose a station this size would need supplies for large scale surface sterilization in the event of pandemic or spaceborne pathogen.
rows.translation: 看到沿墙排列的一罐罐日光色液体，以及上面仍清晰可读的标签时，你立刻明白了这个舱室的用途：消毒剂。你想，这么大的空间站肯定需要储备物资，以便在发生瘟疫或太空病原体入侵时进行大规模表面消毒。
rows.raw: "This chamber’s purpose becomes clear the moment you see the tanks of day-glow fluid lining the walls with their still legible labels: Disinfectant. You suppose a station this size would need supplies for large scale surface sterilization in the event of pandemic or spaceborne pathogen."

rows.original: Your musings are cut short by an abruptly blaring alarm. “Tank pressure rising to unsafe levels!” The muted amber lighting gives way to flashing red. “Seal failure in tank 2!” Behind you, you see a tank with the bold ‘2’ stamped on its surface spraying caustic juice across the door. “Rupture! Evacuate! Sealing chamber. Total containment failure imminent!” The words fly out faster than you can react. The southern door audibly clicks as it seals, locking you inside.
rows.translation: 警报突然尖锐响起，打断了你的思绪。“储罐压力正在升至危险水平！”昏暗的琥珀色灯光被闪烁的红光取代。“2号储罐密封失效！”你看见身后一个表面印着醒目数字“2”的储罐正朝门口喷洒腐蚀性液体。“破裂！立即撤离！舱室封闭中。即将发生全面收容失效！”这些话快得令你来不及反应。南边的门随着一声明显的咔嗒声封死，把你锁在里面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour musings are cut short by an abruptly blaring alarm. “Tank pressure rising to unsafe levels!” The muted amber lighting gives way to flashing red. “Seal failure in tank 2!” Behind you, you see a tank with the bold ‘2’ stamped on its surface spraying caustic juice across the door. “Rupture! Evacuate! Sealing chamber. Total containment failure imminent!” The words fly out faster than you can react. The southern door audibly clicks as it seals, locking you inside."

rows.original: A pipe near the ceiling bursts, spraying more caustic chemicals a few feet away. One fleck lands on your [pc.skinFurScales], burning hotly.
rows.translation: 天花板附近的一根管道爆裂，在几英尺外喷出更多腐蚀性化学品。一滴飞溅物落在你的[pc.skinFurScales]上，灼痛难忍。
rows.raw: "\n\nA pipe near the ceiling bursts, spraying more caustic chemicals a few feet away. One fleck lands on your [pc.skinFurScales], burning hotly."

rows.original: You have no doubt that you’ll die if you don’t do something, but what?
rows.translation: 毫无疑问，再不采取行动你就会死，可该怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have no doubt that you’ll die if you don’t do something, but what?"

rows.translation: 攀爬？
攀爬？

rows.original: You look around for something to climb up, but you’d have to climb onto the rapidly rupturing tanks and pipes to even attempt it - an act certain to result in death.
rows.translation: 你环顾四周寻找可以攀爬的东西，但要想这么做，就得爬上那些正在迅速破裂的储罐和管道 - 此举必死无疑。
rows.raw: "You look around for something to climb up, but you’d have to climb onto the rapidly rupturing tanks and pipes to even attempt it - an act certain to result in death."

rows.translation: 攀爬？

rows.original: Look for a place to climb!
rows.translation: 找个地方爬上去！
物品栏？
物品栏？

rows.original: Taking rapid stock of your inventory,
rows.translation: 你迅速清点物品栏，

rows.original: you recall your survival tent! It doesn’t have enough charge for a full rest, but maybe it has just enough juice left to get you through this...
rows.translation: 想起了自己的生存帐篷！它的电量不足以让你充分休息，但也许还剩下足够的能量帮你渡过这一关...
rows.raw: "you recall your survival tent! It doesn’t have enough charge for a full rest, but maybe it has just enough juice left to get you through this... "

rows.original: you come upon a last minute addition to your kit - a hardlight survival tent.
rows.translation: 发现装备里有件最后一刻才添进去的物品 - 一顶硬光生存帐篷。
rows.raw: "you come upon a last minute addition to your kit - a hardlight survival tent. "

rows.original: you thought you had gotten rid of your hardlight survival tent, but you’re amazed to find a fresh one still on your person!
rows.translation: 你本以为自己已经把硬光生存帐篷丢掉了，却惊讶地发现身上还有一顶崭新的！
rows.raw: "you thought you had gotten rid of your hardlight survival tent, but you’re amazed to find a fresh one still on your person! "

rows.original: Rated to endure extremes of all kinds - including acid rain - it could protect you from the onrushing deluge. All you have to do is hit the button to deploy it and toss it down...
rows.translation: 它能够承受各种极端环境 - 包括酸雨 - 或许能保护你免遭汹涌而来的液体淹没。你只需按下按钮将它展开，再把它扔到地上...
rows.raw: "Rated to endure extremes of all kinds - including acid rain - it could protect you from the onrushing deluge. All you have to do is hit the button to deploy it and toss it down..."

rows.original: (Tutorial: The hardlight tent can be used from the “Rest” menu to sleep and fully recover - or avoid this tide of caustic chemicals! It will need time to recharge after use, but it’s very useful for recovering in the field - or leveling up when a bed isn’t available.)
rows.translation: (教程：你可以从“休息”菜单使用硬光帐篷睡觉并完全恢复 - 或避开这股腐蚀性化学品浪潮！使用后需要时间充能，但它很适合在野外恢复 - 或者在没有床时升级。)
rows.raw: "\n\n(Tutorial: The hardlight tent can be used from the “Rest” menu to sleep and fully recover - or avoid this tide of caustic chemicals! It will need time to recharge after use, but it’s very useful for recovering in the field - or leveling up when a bed isn’t available.)"

rows.translation: 硬光帐篷
物品栏？

rows.original: Check your inventory for something that might help!
rows.translation: 检查物品栏，看看有没有能派上用场的东西！
rows.raw: "Check your inventory for something that might help!"

rows.translation: 射击？
射击？

rows.original: You pull out your [pc.rangedWeapon] and crack off a shot at the southern door. Aside from ringing like the world’s loudest cymbal and leaving you with a concerning ring in your ears, it doesn’t work. It didn’t even leave a mark.
rows.translation: 你拔出[pc.rangedWeapon]，朝南边的门开了一枪。除了让它发出仿佛世界上最响的铜钹一样的巨响，并在你耳中留下一阵令人担忧的嗡鸣之外，毫无效果。甚至连道印子都没留下。
rows.raw: "You pull out your [pc.rangedWeapon] and crack off a shot at the southern door. Aside from ringing like the world’s loudest cymbal and leaving you with a concerning ring in your ears, it doesn’t work. It didn’t even leave a mark."

rows.translation: 射击？

rows.original: Any problem can be solved with force, right?
rows.translation: 任何问题都能靠暴力解决，对吧？
rows.raw: "Any problem can be solved with force, right?"

rows.translation: 射击？
射击？

rows.original: You would need a ranged weapon equipped for this...
rows.translation: 你得装备一件远程武器才能这么做...
rows.raw: "You would need a ranged weapon equipped for this..."

rows.translation: 硬光庇护

rows.original: You deploy the tent and climb inside as you hear another tank rupture. The next blows, and you seal yourself inside, listening to the one after that shatter. It’s like listening to a chaingun in a typhoon: constant cracks and booms blending together with a near-constant pitter-patter. Since the tent itself is formed of hardlight, you can use the controls to turn sections transparent - and watch the entire system finish failing, splashing disinfectant onto the crackling, projected barrier.
rows.translation: 你展开帐篷钻了进去，同时听见另一个储罐破裂。紧接着下一个也炸开了，你把自己封在帐篷内，听着之后又一个储罐碎裂。那声音就像台风中的转轮机枪：接连不断的碎裂与爆响，同几乎不曾停歇的噼啪声混在一起。帐篷本身由硬光构成，你可以通过控制器让一部分变得透明 - 亲眼看着整套系统彻底崩溃，消毒剂泼洒在噼啪作响的投射屏障上。
rows.raw: "You deploy the tent and climb inside as you hear another tank rupture. The next blows, and you seal yourself inside, listening to the one after that shatter. It’s like listening to a chaingun in a typhoon: constant cracks and booms blending together with a near-constant pitter-patter. Since the tent itself is formed of hardlight, you can use the controls to turn sections transparent - and watch the entire system finish failing, splashing disinfectant onto the crackling, projected barrier."

rows.original: What sorts of pressures is this thing rated for again? You hurry to search out the tent’s documentation on your Codex while the fluids finally slosh up to their apex, nearly submerging your pocket of safety in garish, life-ending liquid.
rows.translation: 这东西的额定承压到底是多少来着？液体终于涨到最高点，花哨却致命的液体几乎淹没你的安全小空间；你赶忙在Codex里查找帐篷的说明文件。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat sorts of pressures is this thing rated for again? You hurry to search out the tent’s documentation on your Codex while the fluids finally slosh up to their apex, nearly submerging your pocket of safety in garish, life-ending liquid."

rows.original: Then the disinfectant levels begin to drop. Over the span of a few minutes, perhaps two inches of the dangerous concoction drain away. You suspect there’s a single grate somewhere on the floor, struggling to pipe the wasted industrial sludge into a long forgotten vent.
rows.translation: 随后，消毒剂的液位开始下降。在几分钟里，危险混合物大概退去了两英寸。你猜地板某处只有一个格栅，正费力地把废弃工业污泥排进一条早已被遗忘的通风管。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen the disinfectant levels begin to drop. Over the span of a few minutes, perhaps two inches of the dangerous concoction drain away. You suspect there’s a single grate somewhere on the floor, struggling to pipe the wasted industrial sludge into a long forgotten vent."

rows.translation: 除了等待，别无他法...
下一步
安全休息

rows.original: After an hour, you emerge to a perfectly sanitized (if disheveled) chamber. You store your tent and let its drained batteries recharge
rows.translation: 一小时后，你从帐篷里出来，眼前是一个彻底消过毒的舱室，尽管一片狼藉。你收起帐篷，让耗尽的电池重新充电
rows.raw: "After an hour, you emerge to a perfectly sanitized (if disheveled) chamber. You store your tent and let its drained batteries recharge"

rows.original: . It’s good to know it could save your life even before you find real danger on the Rush.
rows.translation: 。还没在星球大进发中遇到真正的危险，它就已经能救你一命，知道这点真不错。
rows.raw: ". It’s good to know it could save your life even before you find real danger on the Rush."

rows.original: , grateful that enough power was held in reserve to save your life. Who knows what sorts of situations it will help you out with on the Rush!
rows.translation: ，庆幸它储备了足够的电量救你一命。谁知道它还能在星球大进发中帮你度过什么样的难关！
rows.raw: ", grateful that enough power was held in reserve to save your life. Who knows what sorts of situations it will help you out with on the Rush!"

rows.original: (Tutorial: Hardlight survival tents take time to recharge their power cells. Higher grade tents can be used more often to sleep and fully heal in the wild - or level up when you have the XP.)
rows.translation: (教程：硬光生存帐篷的电池需要一段时间才能充满。高级帐篷可以更频繁地用来在野外睡觉并完全恢复 - 或在经验值足够时升级。)
rows.raw: "\n\n(Tutorial: Hardlight survival tents take time to recharge their power cells. Higher grade tents can be used more often to sleep and fully heal in the wild - or level up when you have the XP.)"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: This room houses all kinds of spare parts for the station itself and its associated ships and mining equipment - including the plasma conduit you needed to get your Casstech running again.
rows.translation: 这个房间里存放着空间站本身、附属飞船和采矿设备所需的各种备件 - 其中就包括让你的卡斯泰克重新运转起来所需的等离子导管。
rows.raw: "This room houses all kinds of spare parts for the station itself and its associated ships and mining equipment - including the plasma conduit you needed to get your Casstech running again."

rows.original: With it in hand, all you have to do is get back to your ship and get out of here!
rows.translation: 拿到它之后，你只需回到飞船，离开这里！
rows.raw: " With it in hand, all you have to do is get back to your ship and get out of here!"

rows.translation: 你的财富正在等着你！

rows.original: With it installed, all you have to do is get back to your ship and get out of here!
rows.translation: 安装好它之后，你只需回到飞船，离开这里！
rows.raw: " With it installed, all you have to do is get back to your ship and get out of here!"

rows.translation: 你的财富正在等着你！
前往飞船
前往你的飞船
快速移动到你的飞船

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.YSOLTE_DEFEATED_TIME &&
                      flags.YSOLTE_DEFEATED_TIME + 1440 > GetGameTimestamp()
                      ? ""
                      : ", avoiding any combat on the way"

rows.original: , avoiding any combat on the way
rows.translation: ，途中避开所有战斗
rows.raw: ", avoiding any combat on the way"

rows.original: At last, you break into the maintenance storage room and discover exactly what you were hoping for: a cornucopia of all kinds of spare parts for the station and whatever equipment was meant to be used here - including a plasma conduit you can patch into your ship to get it running again! As fun as it has been dealing with this station of mothballed miscreants, you’re ready to leave.
rows.translation: 你终于闯进机械储藏室，发现了梦寐以求的东西：这里堆满了供空间站及原本在此使用的各种设备所需的备件，其中还有一根等离子导管，可以接进你的飞船，让它重新运转！和这座封存着一群恶棍的空间站打交道虽然颇有趣味，但你已经准备离开了。
rows.raw: "At last, you break into the maintenance storage room and discover exactly what you were hoping for: a cornucopia of all kinds of spare parts for the station and whatever equipment was meant to be used here - including a plasma conduit you can patch into your ship to get it running again! As fun as it has been dealing with this station of mothballed miscreants, you’re ready to leave."

rows.original: (Tutorial: It is recommended you save the game before proceeding further...)
rows.translation: (教程：建议先保存游戏，再继续前进...)
rows.raw: "\n\n(Tutorial: It is recommended you save the game before proceeding further...)"

rows.translation: 拿走导管
拿走导管

rows.original: After all it took to get here, this seems almost... too easy.
rows.translation: 费了这么大力气才来到这里，这似乎有点...太容易了。
rows.raw: "After all it took to get here, this seems almost... too easy."

rows.original: You count yourself lucky to have your Codex and its built-in torch to light the way through the oppressive darkness. You’d hate to bump your head on
rows.translation: 你庆幸自己带着Codex，可以用它内置的照明灯照亮令人压抑的黑暗。你可不想仅仅因为照明条件太差，就一头撞上
rows.raw: "You count yourself lucky to have your Codex and its built-in torch to light the way through the oppressive darkness. You’d hate to bump your head on "

rows.translation: 漂浮的残骸
低垂的横梁

rows.original: and end this adventure before it got started, just because of poor lighting conditions. Sure enough, you come upon a blockage to the north. A cargo sled lies embedded in the walls, carelessly piloted at high speed in such a way that left it wedged firmly in the way - and jumbled the tunnel beyond with its smashed-up cargo.
rows.translation: ，在冒险尚未开始前便草草收场。果然，你在北面遇到了一处堵塞。一辆货运滑车嵌进墙壁，显然有人粗心地以高速驾驶，结果让它牢牢卡在路中间 - 被撞烂的货物也把后方通道堵得乱七八糟。
rows.raw: " and end this adventure before it got started, just because of poor lighting conditions. Sure enough, you come upon a blockage to the north. A cargo sled lies embedded in the walls, carelessly piloted at high speed in such a way that left it wedged firmly in the way - and jumbled the tunnel beyond with its smashed-up cargo."

rows.translation: ...那是个
假阳具

rows.original: wedged under the straps on that crate? Lewd!
rows.translation: ，卡在那个货箱的绑带下面吗？真淫荡！
rows.raw: "wedged under the straps on that crate? Lewd!"

rows.original: You snatch up the dildo and cram it into your pack.
rows.translation: 你一把拿起假阳具，塞进背包。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou snatch up the dildo and cram it into your pack."

rows.translation: 唯一的出口在南边。

rows.original: This winding tunnel worms through FIRST-14’s guts in a slithering, back-and-forth path that only hints at the size of the industrial machines buried behind its walls. Intended for function over form, the gray walls with their single green stripe stretch plainly ahead, north and south, interrupted here and there by
rows.translation: 这条曲折通道在FIRST-14内部蜿蜒穿行，来回盘绕的路径只能让人略微猜到墙后那些工业机械的庞大规模。这里以功能优先，完全不考虑外观；带着一条绿色横线的灰墙朴素地向前延伸，贯通南北，其间偶尔散落着
rows.raw: "This winding tunnel worms through FIRST-14’s guts in a slithering, back-and-forth path that only hints at the size of the industrial machines buried behind its walls. Intended for function over form, the gray walls with their single green stripe stretch plainly ahead, north and south, interrupted here and there by "

joinAfter.expression:
se()
                  ? "the occasional floating crate"
                  : "the occasional smashed crate"

rows.translation: 漂浮的货箱
破损的货箱

rows.original: C-Deck’s gravity control station is even darker than the hallway outside. None of the emergency lights inside are lit. Most control consoles are pitch black and silent. The large wall screen may as well be a square of polished obsidian. Behind you, the door is in even worse shape, misaligned and forever stuck in place in its own frame, passable only thanks to its wildly slanted alignment. If you want to fix the station’s gravity, you’ll need to investigate...
rows.translation: C层的重力控制站甚至比外面的走廊更黑。里面没有一盏应急灯亮着，大多数控制台一片漆黑、毫无声息。墙上的大屏幕简直像一块打磨光滑的黑曜石。你身后的门状况更糟，它已经错位，永远卡死在自己的门框中；只有那严重倾斜的角度勉强留出一道可供通行的缝隙。 如果想修复空间站的重力系统，你需要调查一番...
rows.raw: "C-Deck’s gravity control station is even darker than the hallway outside. None of the emergency lights inside are lit. Most control consoles are pitch black and silent. The large wall screen may as well be a square of polished obsidian. Behind you, the door is in even worse shape, misaligned and forever stuck in place in its own frame, passable only thanks to its wildly slanted alignment.\n\nIf you want to fix the station’s gravity, you’ll need to investigate..."

rows.translation: 调查
熄灯小游戏：

rows.original: • When selecting a button, it will toggle from ‘off’ to ‘on’ (or vice-versa).
rows.translation: • 选择一个按钮时，它会从“关闭”切换为“开启”，反之亦然。
rows.raw:
"
  • When selecting a button, it will toggle from ‘off’ to ‘on’ (or vice-versa).
    • "

rows.original: • When selecting a button, it will also toggle the buttons directly above (or below) and beside it.
rows.translation: • 选择一个按钮时，它还会切换正上方、正下方及相邻按钮的状态。
rows.raw:
"
  • When selecting a button, it will also toggle the buttons directly above (or below) and beside it.
    • "

rows.original: • Some of these puzzles will want all of the buttons ‘on’, some will want them all ‘off’.
rows.translation: • 这类谜题有些要求所有按钮均为“开启”，另一些则要求全部“关闭”。
rows.raw:
"
  • Some of these puzzles will want all of the buttons ‘on’, some will want them all ‘off’.
    • "

rows.translation: 糟了...

rows.original: You hear something sputter and die in the distance... but the whirring fans of the life support systems continue on unimpeded. It’s good that you didn’t wind up killing yourself, but you definitely broke something somewhere on the station. At least this console is still running. You can try again!
rows.translation: 你听见远处有什么东西咳嗽几声，随即停转...但生命维持系统的风扇仍毫无阻碍地嗡嗡运转。你没有把自己害死，这很好；但你肯定弄坏了空间站某处的某个东西。至少这台控制台还在运行。你可以再试一次！
rows.raw: "You hear something sputter and die in the distance... but the whirring fans of the life support systems continue on unimpeded. It’s good that you didn’t wind up killing yourself, but you definitely broke something somewhere on the station. At least this console is still running. You can try again!"

rows.translation: 再试一次
退出
退出

rows.original: Not recommended. This puzzle must be completed to escape from FIRST-14.
rows.translation: 不建议这么做。你必须解开这个谜题才能逃离FIRST-14。
rows.raw: "Not recommended. This puzzle must be completed to escape from FIRST-14."

rows.translation: 成功！

rows.original: Few things are more relaxing than sitting down. Feeling gravity gently tug your rump into the seat you’ve been floating over for the past few minutes is one of them. You sigh happily, watching console after console light up. The screen on the wall flickers once before bursting into joyous luminance, proudly displaying a warbling bar graph of the station’s current gravitation on C-Deck: 0.9-1.069, depending on the distance to the closest generator.
rows.translation: 很少有事情比坐下来更让人放松。过去几分钟里你一直飘在座椅上方，现在感到重力轻轻把屁股拉进座位里，这就是其中之一。你愉快地叹了口气，看着一台又一台控制台亮起。墙上的屏幕闪烁一次，随后迸发出令人欣喜的光芒，自豪地显示出一张波动柱状图，标明空间站C层当前的重力值：视距最近发电机的距离而定，在0.9至1.069之间。
rows.raw: "Few things are more relaxing than sitting down. Feeling gravity gently tug your rump into the seat you’ve been floating over for the past few minutes is one of them. You sigh happily, watching console after console light up. The screen on the wall flickers once before bursting into joyous luminance, proudly displaying a warbling bar graph of the station’s current gravitation on C-Deck: 0.9-1.069, depending on the distance to the closest generator."

rows.original: With gravity on your side, you should be able to push against the airflow that blasted you back into the hangar!
rows.translation: 有了重力相助，你应该能顶着那股曾把你吹回机库的气流前进！
rows.raw: "\n\nWith gravity on your side, you should be able to push against the airflow that blasted you back into the hangar!"

rows.original: Maybe this will help you get into another section of the station?
rows.translation: 也许这能帮你进入空间站的另一区域？
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe this will help you get into another section of the station?"

rows.translation: 下一步
改接电力！

rows.original: To power on the gravity, you’ll need to ‘light up’ all of the input buttons below.
rows.translation: 要启动重力系统，你得“点亮”下方所有输入按钮。
rows.raw: "To power on the gravity, you’ll need to ‘light up’ all of the input buttons below."

rows.original: This particular version of the puzzle should have all the buttons set to ‘on’ to win. Don’t turn them all off, or you’re going to have a bad time...
rows.translation: 这一版本的谜题要求把所有按钮都设为“开启”才能获胜。别把它们全关掉，否则你会倒大霉的...
rows.raw: "\nThis particular version of the puzzle should have all the buttons set to ‘on’ to win. Don’t turn them all off, or you’re going to have a bad time..."

rows.translation: 下一步
重力控制

rows.original: Floating over to the lone functional console, you page through every available diagnostic in sequence. Most of the generators are intact and functional. They were shut down hard, powered off for what was supposed to be the last time, when Steele Tech ceased their operations here and pulled their personnel out.
rows.translation: 你飘到唯一还能使用的控制台前，依次翻阅所有可用的诊断信息。大多数发电机都完好无损且功能正常。斯蒂尔科技停止此地运营并撤走人员时，曾强制关停这些设备，并关闭了电源，原本以为那会是最后一次。
rows.raw: "Floating over to the lone functional console, you page through every available diagnostic in sequence. Most of the generators are intact and functional. They were shut down hard, powered off for what was supposed to be the last time, when Steele Tech ceased their operations here and pulled their personnel out."

rows.original: If you want to get them running again, you’ll need to reconfigure the local grid to deliver power to them once more - and do so evenly, without causing a blackout. This station won’t be habitable for long once life support cuts out and the atmospheric containment fields in the hangar collapse...
rows.translation: 如果想让它们重新运转，你需要重新配置本地电网，再次为其供电 - 而且必须均匀供电，不能引发停电。一旦生命维持系统停止，机库的大气收容力场崩溃，这座空间站很快就会变得不宜居住...
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you want to get them running again, you’ll need to reconfigure the local grid to deliver power to them once more - and do so evenly, without causing a blackout. This station won’t be habitable for long once life support cuts out and the atmospheric containment fields in the hangar collapse..."

rows.translation: 改接电力
改接电力

rows.original: You’ll need to reconfigure the local grid to deliver power to them once more - and do so evenly, without causing a blackout. This station won’t be habitable for long once life support cuts out and the atmospheric containment fields in the hangar collapse...
rows.translation: 你需要重新配置本地电网，再次为它们供电 - 而且必须均匀供电，不能引发停电。一旦生命维持系统停止，机库的大气收容力场崩溃，这座空间站很快就会变得不宜居住...
rows.raw: "You’ll need to reconfigure the local grid to deliver power to them once more - and do so evenly, without causing a blackout. This station won’t be habitable for long once life support cuts out and the atmospheric containment fields in the hangar collapse..."

rows.translation: 返回
调查

rows.original: See if you can get the station’s gravity up and running again.
rows.translation: 看看能不能让空间站的重力系统重新运转。
rows.raw: "See if you can get the station’s gravity up and running again."

rows.original: Thanks to your meddling, C-Deck has its gravity back - and your [pc.footOrFeet]
rows.translation: 多亏你的折腾，C层恢复了重力 - 你的[pc.footOrFeet]
rows.raw: "Thanks to your meddling, C-Deck has its gravity back - and your [pc.footOrFeet] "

rows.translation: 正
都

rows.original:
securely planted on the ground once more. Better yet, the consoles in this control room are powered up and functional once more. You could even dial the Gs up or down, if you felt like deviating from the Terran standard employed on most Steele Tech-operated stations.

The western door is still broken, of course, but you can squeeze through the gap in the frame, even if gravity makes for some uncomfortable wiggling.
rows.translation:
也再次稳稳踩在地面上。更棒的是，这间控制室里的控制台也重新通电并恢复功能。若想偏离大多数斯蒂尔科技空间站采用的泰伦标准，你甚至可以随意调高或调低重力。

当然，西边的门仍然坏着，不过你可以从门框的缝隙挤过去，哪怕有了重力之后，扭动身体通过会有些难受。
rows.raw: " securely planted on the ground once more. Better yet, the consoles in this control room are powered up and functional once more. You could even dial the Gs up or down, if you felt like deviating from the Terran standard employed on most Steele Tech-operated stations.\n\nThe western door is still broken, of course, but you can squeeze through the gap in the frame, even if gravity makes for some uncomfortable wiggling."

rows.original: There’s a familiar poster on the wall! You’d recognize the ol’ Steele Tech ring and hex design anywhere - you saw it so often growing up that just noticing the font brings a swell of warm nostalgia to your heart.
rows.translation: 墙上有一张熟悉的海报！斯蒂尔科技那套老掉牙的圆环加六边形设计，你无论在哪里都认得出来 - 小时候你见过它太多次，以至于仅仅注意到这种字体，心中便涌起一股温暖的怀旧情绪。
rows.raw: "There’s a familiar poster on the wall! You’d recognize the ol’ Steele Tech ring and hex design anywhere - you saw it so often growing up that just noticing the font brings a swell of warm nostalgia to your heart."

rows.translation: 拿走海报
拿走海报

rows.original: Grab the poster - maybe it will look nice in your ship!
rows.translation: 拿走海报 - 也许挂在你的飞船里会很好看！
rows.raw: "Grab the poster - maybe it will look nice in your ship!"

rows.original: There used to be a Steele Tech poster hanging on the wall here, but you swiped it. It’s yours now. Nobody was looking at a poster on an abandoned station anyway.
rows.translation: 这里的墙上原本挂着一张斯蒂尔科技海报，但你顺走了。现在它属于你。反正也没人会在一座废弃空间站里看海报。
rows.raw: "There used to be a Steele Tech poster hanging on the wall here, but you swiped it. It’s yours now. Nobody was looking at a poster on an abandoned station anyway."

rows.original: The green-lined tunnel runs east and west.
rows.translation: 带绿色线条的通道向东西两侧延伸。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe green-lined tunnel runs east and west."

rows.original: The corridor grows more dangerous here. Someone removed two of the deckplates from this tunnel, leaving dangerous snarls of wiring
rows.translation: 这里的走廊更加危险。有人拆走了通道里的两块甲板，留下危险而纠结的电线
rows.raw: "The corridor grows more dangerous here. Someone removed two of the deckplates from this tunnel, leaving dangerous snarls of wiring "

joinAfter.expression:
se()
                  ? "to potentially float up and entangle you. So long as you take care to float up to the ceiling before passing by, you should be fine."
                  : "to trip and entangle the unwary. So long as you pick your footholds carefully, you should be fine."

rows.original: to potentially float up and entangle you. So long as you take care to float up to the ceiling before passing by, you should be fine.
rows.translation: ，它们可能会飘起来缠住你。只要小心地先飘到天花板附近再经过这里，应该就不会有事。
rows.raw: "to potentially float up and entangle you. So long as you take care to float up to the ceiling before passing by, you should be fine."

rows.original: to trip and entangle the unwary. So long as you pick your footholds carefully, you should be fine.
rows.translation: ，可能会绊倒并缠住粗心的人。只要谨慎选择落脚点，应该就不会有事。
rows.raw: "to trip and entangle the unwary. So long as you pick your footholds carefully, you should be fine."

rows.original:
Hopefully Steele Tech has gotten a little better about cable management in the last century. This entire mess could’ve been avoided with a few industrial zip ties.

This corridor continues its merry march east and west through the husk of FIRST-14. There would be another tunnel to the south, but someone crashed a cargo hauler into it at speed, walling it off.
rows.translation:
希望过去一个世纪里，斯蒂尔科技在电缆管理方面有所长进。这一团乱麻本可以靠几根工业扎带彻底避免。

这条走廊继续欢快地向东西两侧穿过FIRST-14的残骸。南边本来也有一条通道，但有人高速驾驶货运车撞进那里，把路彻底堵死了。
rows.raw: " Hopefully Steele Tech has gotten a little better about cable management in the last century. This entire mess could’ve been avoided with a few industrial zip ties.\n\nThis corridor continues its merry march east and west through the husk of FIRST-14. There would be another tunnel to the south, but someone crashed a cargo hauler into it at speed, walling it off."

rows.original: In the ancient station’s dim emergency lighting, it’s easy to miss details, but there’s no missing the functional pneumatic doorway to the west or the flickering sign above it: Communication Station Charlie.
rows.translation: 在古老空间站昏暗的应急灯光下，很容易漏看细节，但西侧那道仍能工作的气动门和上方闪烁的标牌绝不可能被忽视：查理通信站。
rows.raw: "In the ancient station’s dim emergency lighting, it’s easy to miss details, but there’s no missing the functional pneumatic doorway to the west or the flickering sign above it: Communication Station Charlie. "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isBimbo() || isSillyModeEnabled()
                  ? "Charlie must be a really important guy! "
                  : ""

rows.original: “So what’s your story?” “I am T1-K4, or as my developers dubbed me, Tika! I am a virtual intelligence medical technician, prototype model number four of four. My role here is to provide supplementary medical care to the workers on the mining platform, but please note that I am not a replacement for an emergency medical crew. I cannot perform complex surgery or respond to calls outside the reach of my mounting. As a prototype myself, I was also deemed a valid platform to test experimental treatments on consenting workers. Two birds with one stone, as the saying goes.” Well, Tika being a prototype explains why you’ve never seen a robot quite like her before. You guess Steele Tech didn’t bother going into production on a whole line of Tikas. Not too surprising considering she can’t even move. Still... Victor Steele does not like to waste perfectly good resources, especially a perfectly functional T1-K4 prototype! A company representative will come any day now to retrieve me!” You glance over your shoulder at the dusty, dark hallway you just came out of. [pc.isMischievous |“Yeah, sure... they’ll be back any time now. Riiiight.” “Your sudden change in pitch indicates you are lying. But why...” |“I’m not sure they’re coming back, Tika...” “Surely you are mistaken!” ] the robotic nurse huffs, frowning. “My overseer assured me...” Seeing how long this place has been abandoned by anybody but outlaw scavengers, it’s hard to believe there’s any hope of anyone from Steele Tech coming back here. Though that does make your situation feel more dire, too. There’s certainly no rescue party coming. Tika forces a little laugh. “Well, until my overseer returns, please feel free to make use of any of my services. It is important to be useful, after all, and I am confident that the research and development group will be most pleased with all the diagnostics I have collected since the last time they checked up on me. Perhaps they are simply waiting until I hit a data-gathering milestone...” [pc.isAss |Damn, this robot’s really acting like it’s a person. Like she’s lonely. What kinda jackass programs a robot to sound like that, huh? |Aw. She may just be a computer, but even still... that’s just kinda sad. ]
rows.translation: “那么，你有什么故事？” “我是T1-K4，或者用开发者给我的昵称来说，蒂卡！我是一名虚拟智能医疗技师，也是四台原型机中的第四号型号。我在这里的职责是为采矿平台上的工人提供辅助医疗服务，但请注意，我无法取代急救医疗队。我不能执行复杂手术，也无法响应固定底座范围之外的呼叫。由于我本身就是原型机，也被认定为适合在自愿参与的工人身上测试实验治疗的平台。俗话说，一举两得。” 蒂卡是原型机，这解释了你为何从未见过像她这样的机器人。你猜斯蒂尔科技最终没有批量生产整条蒂卡产品线。考虑到她甚至无法移动，这倒不怎么意外。 不过... [pc.isAss |“所以公司撤离时就把你忘了？”你问道。 |[pc.isMischievous |“那么...公司以后会回来接你，还是...？” |“就这样把你留在这里，似乎太浪费了...”你提到。 ] ] 蒂卡把头歪向一边，模仿人类的困惑。“公司会回来的，傻瓜！维克托·斯蒂尔不喜欢浪费完好的资源，尤其是一台功能完全正常的T1-K4原型机！公司代表随时都会来接我！” 你回头看了一眼刚走出来的昏暗走廊，里面尘土飞扬。[pc.isMischievous |“对，当然...他们随时都会回来。没——错。” “你突然改变语调，说明你在撒谎。但为什么...” |“我不确定他们还会回来，蒂卡...” “你肯定弄错了！” ]机器人护士皱着眉，气呼呼地说道。“我的主管向我保证过...” 这里已经荒废如此之久，除了违法拾荒者再没别人，很难相信斯蒂尔科技还有任何人会回来。不过，这也让你的处境显得更加严峻。肯定不会有救援队前来。 蒂卡勉强笑了一声。“好吧，在主管回来之前，请随意使用我的任何服务。毕竟发挥作用很重要；而且我相信，研究开发小组会对上次检查以来我所收集的全部诊断数据感到非常满意。也许他们只是等我达到某个数据收集里程碑...” [pc.isAss |该死，这个机器人真的表现得像个人，仿佛她很孤独。到底什么混蛋会把机器人编程得说出这种话，嗯？ |唉。她也许只是一台计算机，但即使如此...还是有点令人难过。 ]
rows.raw: " “So what’s your story?” “I am T1-K4, or as my developers dubbed me, Tika! I am a virtual intelligence medical technician, prototype model number four of four. My role here is to provide supplementary medical care to the workers on the mining platform, but please note that I am not a replacement for an emergency medical crew. I cannot perform complex surgery or respond to calls outside the reach of my mounting. As a prototype myself, I was also deemed a valid platform to test experimental treatments on consenting workers. Two birds with one stone, as the saying goes.” Well, Tika being a prototype explains why you’ve never seen a robot quite like her before. You guess Steele Tech didn’t bother going into production on a whole line of Tikas. Not too surprising considering she can’t even move. Still... [pc.isAss |“So did the company just forget you when they pulled out?” you ask. |[pc.isMischievous |“So... is the company coming back to get you at some point, or...?” |“It seems like such a waste to just leave you here...” you mention. ] ] Tika quirks her head to the side, feigning human confusion. “The company is coming back, silly! Victor Steele does not like to waste perfectly good resources, especially a perfectly functional T1-K4 prototype! A company representative will come any day now to retrieve me!” You glance over your shoulder at the dusty, dark hallway you just came out of. [pc.isMischievous |“Yeah, sure... they’ll be back any time now. Riiiight.” “Your sudden change in pitch indicates you are lying. But why...” |“I’m not sure they’re coming back, Tika...” “Surely you are mistaken!” ] the robotic nurse huffs, frowning. “My overseer assured me...” Seeing how long this place has been abandoned by anybody but outlaw scavengers, it’s hard to believe there’s any hope of anyone from Steele Tech coming back here. Though that does make your situation feel more dire, too. There’s certainly no rescue party coming. Tika forces a little laugh. “Well, until my overseer returns, please feel free to make use of any of my services. It is important to be useful, after all, and I am confident that the research and development group will be most pleased with all the diagnostics I have collected since the last time they checked up on me. Perhaps they are simply waiting until I hit a data-gathering milestone...” [pc.isAss |Damn, this robot’s really acting like it’s a person. Like she’s lonely. What kinda jackass programs a robot to sound like that, huh? |Aw. She may just be a computer, but even still... that’s just kinda sad. ] "
